security_audit.summary: The reported shell backtick findings are Markdown formatting, not Ruby or shell command substitution. Most URLs are documentation or placeholders, but the remote image can contact an external host when rendered. The broad Bash(belt *) permission remains a medium-risk capability because it permits more CLI actions than this image workflow requires.

remediation.issue: The allowed-tools declaration permits every belt subcommand.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict automatic Bash access to required image listing and generation commands, or remove the blanket allowance and require command confirmation.

remediation.issue: The skill embeds an image hosted on an external inference.sh domain.
remediation.suggestion: Package the image with the skill or use a marketplace-hosted asset to avoid automatic requests to an external host.

content.user_title: Generate and Edit Images with AI
content.value_statement: Choosing and invoking image models can require repeated CLI research. This skill provides model guidance and ready workflows for generation, editing, upscaling, and stitching.
actual_capabilities: Lists image applications available through the belt CLI.
Generates images from text prompts with supported hosted models.
Edits existing images from user-provided image URLs.
Selects models for LoRA styles, text rendering, speed, or image quality.
Upscales images and stitches multiple images through dedicated applications.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh belt CLI and an authenticated account.
Generation sends prompts and supplied image URLs to remote model services.
Model availability, pricing, accepted inputs, and output quality can change.
The skill provides CLI guidance but does not include local image models.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate product scenes, social graphics, and promotional images in selected aspect ratios.

use_cases.title: Explore Visual Concepts
use_cases.description: Compare model outputs for characters, environments, posters, and presentation concepts.

use_cases.title: Automate Image Preparation
use_cases.description: Edit, upscale, or stitch source images through repeatable CLI workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Basic Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an image of [subject] in [style]. Use [aspect ratio] and choose a suitable model.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Product Visual
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a professional product image for [product]. Use [background], [lighting], [camera angle], and [aspect ratio].
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a marketing or catalog visual.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an Existing Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit the image at [image URL]. Change [requested element] while preserving [details to keep]. Select a model suited to editing.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Model Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend three available models for [goal]. Compare quality, speed, cost, text rendering, and editing support before generating the selected option.
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose a model for a constrained production workflow.

output_examples.input: Create a wide product image of white sneakers with studio lighting.
output_examples.output: Selected GPT-Image-2 for high-quality product photography. Generated a wide studio scene with white sneakers, controlled shadows, and a clean neutral background.

output_examples.input: Change my source image background to a beach sunset.
output_examples.output: Selected an image-editing model. Preserved the main subject while replacing the background with a warm beach sunset.

output_examples.input: Improve a small image for print.
output_examples.output: Selected the Topaz image upscaler. Produced a higher-resolution image intended for closer review before printing.

best_practices: Specify the subject, composition, lighting, style, and aspect ratio.
Review model pricing and input requirements before running generation.
Use trusted image URLs without embedded credentials or sensitive query parameters.
anti_patterns: Do not send confidential images or prompts without reviewing provider policies.
Do not assume every model supports editing, LoRA, or identical parameters.
Do not install related skills unless they are required and independently reviewed.

faq.question: What must I install before using this skill?
faq.answer: Install the inference.sh belt CLI and authenticate with an inference.sh account.

faq.question: Which image models are supported?
faq.answer: The guide covers GPT-Image-2, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, Reve, ImagineArt, P-Image, and other belt image applications.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. Supported editing models accept a user-provided image URL and a requested transformation.

faq.question: Can it create images with readable text?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide identifies models designed for text rendering, including Reve and Seedream options.

faq.question: Does image generation run locally?
faq.answer: No. The belt CLI sends requests to hosted inference services.

faq.question: Can it upscale or combine images?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented applications include Topaz upscaling and horizontal image stitching.
